en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sahl, from his father who said,

‘I asked Abu Al Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> about the man who rents the house and the ship from the man for a year, or more or less. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Its rent is necessitated up to the time which he had hired it to, and the choice regarding taking the rent is up to its owner, if he so desires to he takes, and if he so desires to he leaves’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Sahl from his father who has said the following:

“Regarding my question before abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who rents a ship or house from another man for a year or more or less. He (the Imam) said, ‘Payment of rent up to the end of the term is incumbent, but accepting payment of rent or leaving it is up to the owner who may like to receive or leave it.’”
